title.zh: 用于早期设计筛选的模拟工作台。
title.en: A simulation workbench for early design decisions.

summary.zh: 在 Mac 上集中管理几何模型、计算假设、模拟结果和审阅材料，帮助比较早期设计方案。
summary.en: A Mac app that brings geometry, assumptions, simulation results, and review materials together to help compare early design options.

contribution.zh: 我想把机械工程中遇到的问题做成原生软件工具。目前的工作包括 Swift 与 Metal 界面、Rust 求解流程，以及输入和结果的追溯。
contribution.en: I started Anvil to build native software for mechanical engineering problems. My work includes Swift and Metal interfaces, Rust simulation workflows, and tracing results back to their inputs.

decision.zh: 把计算设置和适用限制与结果放在一起，方便审阅。AI 可以协助准备与检查，工程判断仍由人作出。
decision.en: Show the setup and limitations alongside the results so they can be reviewed together. AI can help with preparation and review; engineering judgment remains with the person using it.

boundary.zh: 部分模拟流程已在限定范围内进行数值检查，其他流程仍用于回放或探索。尚未与物理实验对照验证，也未获得工程认证。
boundary.en: Some simulation workflows have numerical checks within a limited scope; others are still exploratory or replay-based. They have not been validated against physical experiments or certified for engineering use.

alt.zh: Anvil Sim 开发预览，展示结构、热与流体模拟流程及各自的限制说明
alt.en: Anvil Sim development preview showing structural, thermal, and fluid workflows with their limitations

caption.zh: 开发预览 · 早期设计筛选流程
caption.en: Development preview · early design screening workflows

sourceNote.zh: 依据项目说明、验证范围文档与保留的开发预览。这里不把演示等同于客户交付。
sourceNote.en: Based on project documentation, stated verification scope, and the retained development preview. A demonstration does not establish customer delivery.

eyebrow.zh: 感知 × 控制 × 硬件

title.zh: 在小车上连接视觉与控制。
title.en: Connecting computer vision to vehicle control.

summary.zh: 一个小型自动驾驶车项目，结合视觉感知、嵌入式计算、车道跟随与转向控制。
summary.en: A small autonomous-vehicle project combining visual perception, embedded computing, lane following, and steering control.

contribution.zh: 我在 Jetson Nano 上运行车道跟随程序，并用 ROS2、YOLOv5 和 OpenCV 构建物体检测流程，将视觉处理与车辆硬件连接起来。
contribution.en: I worked on lane-following software running on a Jetson Nano and an object-detection pipeline using ROS2, YOLOv5, and OpenCV, integrating computer vision with the vehicle’s hardware.

decision.zh: 在同一台车上调试感知与控制，处理摄像头、计算程序和执行机构之间的配合问题。
decision.en: Develop perception and control on the same vehicle, where the camera, software, and actuators have to work together.

boundary.zh: 这是小型实验车辆项目，不代表公共道路自动驾驶能力。
boundary.en: This was a small experimental vehicle, not a demonstration of public-road autonomy.

alt.zh: 项目小车，车架上装有摄像头、计算板、连线和控制硬件
alt.en: The project vehicle with a camera, compute board, wiring, and control hardware mounted on its chassis

caption.zh: 项目实物 · 摄像头、计算与控制
caption.en: Project hardware · sensing, computation, and control

sourceNote.zh: 依据本人先前公开的项目描述与实物照片；未保留足够测试依据的准确率数字不在此引用。
sourceNote.en: Based on my earlier public project account and hardware photograph. Accuracy figures without sufficient retained test evidence are omitted.

eyebrow.zh: 生活记录 × 产品设计

title.zh: 用一座花园，记录日常的积累。
title.en: A growing garden for your everyday life.

summary.zh: 一个实验性的 iPhone 应用，把日记、习惯、日历和专注记录与花园的生长联系起来。
summary.en: An experimental iPhone app that connects journaling, habits, a calendar, and focus sessions to a garden that grows over time.

contribution.zh: 我想尝试另一种记录生活的方式：既能翻看某一天的细节，也能看见日积月累的变化。
contribution.en: I’m exploring a way to record everyday life that lets you revisit individual days and see a longer record take shape.

decision.zh: 时间线保留每天的细节，花园呈现长期的积累，让记录值得经常回看。
decision.en: Keep the daily details in a timeline and reflect their accumulation in the garden, giving people a reason to return to their records.

boundary.zh: 仍处于原型开发阶段，尚未公开发布。预览中的记录为虚构示例。
boundary.en: A prototype in development, not yet publicly released. The preview uses fictional sample entries.

alt.zh: Life Garden 开发界面，包含日记记录、专注时间和一座小花园，使用虚构演示数据
alt.en: Life Garden prototype showing journal entries, focus time, and a small garden with fictional sample data

caption.zh: 开发版界面 · 虚构示例记录

sourceNote.zh: 依据保留的开发截图与项目介绍；截图中的记录均为示例。
sourceNote.en: Based on the retained development screen and project description. All records shown are examples.

eyebrow.zh: AI 开发 × 工作连续性

title.zh: 让 AI 协作接得上前一次的工作。
title.en: Picking up where an AI work session left off.

summary.zh: 一个轻量工作工具，用于记录项目进度、通过 Git 保护改动并保存验证结果，方便继续开发、检查和回退。
summary.en: A lightweight tool for recording project state, preserving changes with Git, and keeping verification results, so AI-assisted work is easier to resume, review, and roll back.

contribution.zh: 我用它探索怎样与 AI 持续协作，让项目进度、代码改动和验证结果能够互相对应。
contribution.en: I use it to explore longer-running work with AI, keeping project state connected to the corresponding code changes and verification results.

decision.zh: 简化任务编排，保留恢复项目进度、保护改动和执行必要检查的功能。
decision.en: Simplify task orchestration around three needs: resuming work, preserving changes, and running the relevant checks.

boundary.zh: 目前仅作为内部工具使用，尚未证明能提高模型准确率，或普遍适用于不同团队。
boundary.en: An internal tool. It has not been shown to improve model accuracy or to suit a wide range of teams.

sourceNote.zh: 依据现行项目说明和轻量化设计记录；没有把历史测试次数作为效果指标。
sourceNote.en: Based on the current project description and simplification record. Historical test counts are not treated as measures of effectiveness.

eyebrow.zh: 世界贸易 × 物品制造
eyebrow.en: Global trade × how things are made

title.zh: 从贸易地图，看材料与制造。
title.en: Exploring materials and manufacturing through trade.

summary.zh: 从国家间的贸易关系出发，了解矿物、材料、工艺和设备，追溯日常物品的来源与生产过程。
summary.en: Explore trade between countries, then look at the minerals, materials, processes, and equipment behind everyday goods.

contribution.zh: 我把公开数据与制造知识整理进原生 iOS 应用，让用户可以从地图上的贸易关系继续查看具体商品与生产过程。
contribution.en: I’m building a native iOS app that brings together public data and manufacturing knowledge, linking trade maps to individual goods and how they are made.

decision.zh: 保留数据的来源与时间，并让地图上的贸易关系连接到相关材料与工艺。
decision.en: Show the source and date of the data, and connect trade relationships on the map to the relevant materials and processes.

boundary.zh: 覆盖范围仍有限。地图展示贸易关系，并非实际航运路线；数据也不是实时更新。
boundary.en: Coverage is still limited. The map shows trade relationships, not shipping routes, and the data is not real-time.

alt.zh: Pulse 铁矿石贸易地图，展示澳大利亚、巴西与中国等国家的贸易关系，数据为 CEPII BACI 2024 年
alt.en: Pulse iron-ore trade map showing relationships among countries including Australia, Brazil, and China, using CEPII BACI 2024 data

caption.zh: 应用截图 · CEPII BACI，2024 年

sourceNote.zh: 依据项目说明与保留的原生应用截图；不声称已在 App Store 公开发布。
sourceNote.en: Based on project documentation and the retained native app screen. Public App Store availability is not claimed.
